About VGS
VGS is building the trust infrastructure for a new era of commerce. As commerce becomes agentic, payments are increasing dramatically in volume, speed, and complexity, and the companies driving that shift need a foundation they can fully trust.

That's where VGS comes in. We're the world's leader in payment tokenization, trusted by the most innovative AI and Fortune 500 companies, merchants, banks, and fintechs to power modern payments and agentic commerce. We store more than 9 billion tokens and process more than 10 billion monthly interactions, touching a third of all e-commerce. That scale isn't incidental. It's why leading companies embed our universal token vault and credential management platform directly into their stack, taming the complexity of payment data so they can move faster.

Come build the platform that enables modern payments for the world's largest companies. We're helping businesses unlock new possibilities in an industry that never stops moving. And that takes exceptional people.
 

 
About the Role
The Director, Strategic Partnerships – Payments & Product will lead the expansion of VGS's strategic partner ecosystem - building relationships with card networks, investors, cloud providers, and emerging payments infrastructure players that directly shape our product strategy and platform capabilities.
 
This role blends external partner engagement with internal product collaboration. You’ll help shape our product roadmap by bringing ecosystem insights and partnership-led opportunities to life - whether through expanding our card network services, accelerating agentic tokens, or other innovative initiatives.
 

 
What You'll Do
Lead and develop a team of Strategic Partnerships professionals, including direct reports, setting clear priorities, coaching performance, and building the team’s capabilities as VGS’s partnership portfolio and strategic mandate expand.
Own and grow a portfolio of VGS’s most strategic partnerships across payments and commerce technology, including card networks, investors, cloud and infrastructure providers, AI platforms, wallets, processors, and other ecosystem partners.
Develop and execute partnership strategies that advance VGS’s company and product priorities, identifying where external partners can accelerate growth, strengthen product differentiation, or open new markets and distribution channels.
Lead complex, product-oriented partnerships that require deep coordination across Product, Engineering, Legal, Sales, and Executive Leadership, translating strategic opportunities into executable commercial and technical plans.
Source, evaluate, prioritize, and develop new strategic partnerships, with a focus on opportunities that can materially influence VGS’s product roadmap, competitive positioning, or long-term growth.
Lead negotiations for strategic commercial and product agreements, including defining partnership structures, economics, go-to-market models, technical commitments, and mutual success criteria.
Drive partnerships from initial strategy and business case through negotiation, launch, commercialization, and ongoing relationship management.
Build senior-level relationships with partner executives and serve as a trusted strategic counterpart, identifying opportunities to expand the partnership and proactively addressing risks or areas of misalignment.
Establish clear goals, operating rhythms, and success metrics for key partnerships, holding both VGS and partners accountable for execution and measurable outcomes.
Act as the voice of strategic partners within VGS, bringing external market insights, partner priorities, and ecosystem developments into product and company decision-making.
Influence VGS’s broader corporate and product strategy by developing a point of view on the evolution of tokenization, payments infrastructure, agentic commerce, AI, and next-generation commerce technologies.
Identify emerging ecosystem shifts and translate them into actionable recommendations for VGS, including potential new products, partnerships, distribution models, and strategic initiatives.
Represent VGS externally with senior leaders across the payments and technology ecosystem, strengthening VGS’s position as a strategic infrastructure partner for the next generation of commerce.
 
 

 
What You Bring
10+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, fintech BD, product strategy, or payments consulting
Understanding of the payments ecosystem—issuers, processors, card networks, wallets, and commerce platforms
Ability to connect technical product functionality with partner and market needs
Demonstrated success managing complex partnerships and cross-functional projects
Comfortable in ambiguous, fast-paced environments with shifting priorities and emerging technologies
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a strategic mindset and a bias toward execution

Nice to Have:
Experience with tokenization, payment processing, cryptology, or security products
BA/BS degree
A knack for out-of-the-box thinking that thrives in a fast-paced startup environment
Experience working closely with product or engineering teams in a platform company or fintech infrastructure provider, especially in an innovative and fast paced startup environment
Familiarity with tokenization, payment flows, reconciliation processes, or data compliance frameworks
Technical literacy (e.g., comfortable discussing APIs, SDKs, and integration workflows)

Engineering at VGS
VGS is building the platform powering agentic commerce and global payments infrastructure. VGS Engineering is the pillar that supports that vision. We create a platform that is an indispensable, ubiquitous component of our partners' payments and security infrastructure. We build and operate high-scale, reliable, and resilient systems that manage mission-critical payment data across the globe. We don't just participate in the payments ecosystem; we power it.
 
Our Environment & Culture
Modern Tooling as Leverage: We value speed and impact. To ensure nothing slows you down, we arm you with a highly consistent modern stack (e.g. AWS, Kubernetes, Java, TypeScript, Python) and world-class AI-augmented SDLC tooling. We strip away the friction so you can focus on the problems that demand creativity and judgment. 
Ownership of Outcomes: Scaling global payments infrastructure requires individuals who take personal ownership of outcomes from day one. We look for builders who combine high agency with deep strategic alignment; channeling their urgency and relentless iteration into what matters most. 
Mission-Critical Accountability: We power payments infrastructure for global market leaders, making system trust and integrity our core deliverable. We don't treat compliance (PCI, SOC2, ISO27001), security patching, and platform maintenance as administrative overhead—we engineer them with first-class product discipline.  In payments infrastructure, reliability is not background work, it’s part of what customers buy.
 
Learn More: See how our engineering practices drive trust and innovation in our official blog and our reliability practices.
 

 
About the Role
As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer, you will be a key contributor and technical practitioner on our Platform Engineering team. You will help build, scale, and fortify global cloud infrastructure designed to handle mission-critical, high-throughput payments applications with zero downtime. You will own core platform components powering our payment systems. Working collaboratively within your team, you will execute infrastructure projects, uphold reliability standards, and help maintain our multi-region AWS environment. We are looking for hands-on engineers who take pride in solving complex distributed system challenges and continuously improving operational efficiency. If you thrive on solving technical infrastructure problems, building automated resiliency, and applying modern SRE practices, we want to build the future with you.
 
Build Immutable, Self-Healing Systems: Build, maintain, and optimize high-availability AWS infrastructure. You will contribute directly to our evolution toward a standardized, globally scalable fleet managed entirely through code.
Drive Resiliency & Automation: Reduce manual toil by implementing automated infrastructure solutions using GitOps, modern CI/CD pipelines, and IaC.
Deep Observability & Resiliency: Configure and maintain telemetry tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) to monitor performance and spot bottlenecks. You will participate in incident response on-call rotations and lead blameless post-mortems.
Enable Engineering Velocity: Partner with Product, Security, and Core Engineering teams to support adoption of "Golden Paths" that streamline developer workflows. You will mentor junior and mid-level engineers and foster strong technical practices.
Customer Impact: Maintain and support high-performance, low-latency private connectivity for external customer traffic. Partner with internal engineering teams to support platform adoption.

 

 
What You Bring
Ownership at Scale: 5+ years of experience contributing to complex, large-scale distributed systems within mission-critical environments.
AWS & Infrastructure-as-Code: Solid hands-on proficiency in AWS ecosystems and Terraform for building reproducible environments.
Containerization & Orchestration: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (EKS), Docker, and GitOps workflows (Flux, Argo, GitHub Actions).
Automation & Scripting: Proficient coding/scripting skills in Python, Go, or Bash for infrastructure automation and operational tooling.
Observability Expertise: Hands-on experience working with Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry.
Security & Networking Foundations: Good understanding of cloud security, API Gateways, load balancing, and network isolation principles.
Nice to Have:
Experience with tokenization, payment processing, or security products
BA/BS degree
A knack for out-of-the-box thinking that thrives in a fast-paced startup environment
Experience with distributed data streaming platforms like Kafka (MSK).
Database performance tuning or query troubleshooting skills.
Familiarity with Java / Spring Framework services.
 
We're looking for passionate professionals who take pride in their craft and want to help grow a team tackling some of the most critical problems in payments. People who thrive here are curious by nature, unafraid of hard problems, and motivated by the chance to build something that matters at scale.

If you're driven to make a meaningful impact, work at the leading edge of payment technology, and grow your career alongside a team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning, you'll feel right at home at VGS.

About VGS

VGS is building the trust infrastructure for a new era of commerce. As commerce becomes agentic, payments are increasing dramatically in volume, speed, and complexity, and the companies driving that shift need a foundation they can fully trust.

That's where VGS comes in. We're the world's leader in payment tokenization, trusted by the most innovative AI and Fortune 500 companies, merchants, banks, and fintechs to power modern payments and agentic commerce. We store more than 9 billion tokens and process more than 10 billion monthly interactions, touching a third of all e-commerce. That scale isn't incidental. It's why leading companies embed our universal token vault and credential management platform directly into their stack, taming the complexity of payment data so they can move faster.

Come build the platform that enables modern payments for the world's largest companies. We're helping businesses unlock new possibilities in an industry that never stops moving. And that takes exceptional people.

 

 

Trusted Engineering That Matters

Engineering at VGS

VGS is building the platform powering agentic commerce and global payments infrastructure. VGS Engineering is the pillar that supports that vision. We create a platform that is an indispensable, ubiquitous component of our partners' payments and security infrastructure. We build and operate high-scale, reliable, and resilient systems that manage mission-critical payment data across the globe. We don't just participate in the payments ecosystem; we power it.

 

Our Environment & Culture

  • Modern Tooling as Leverage: We value speed and impact. To ensure nothing slows you down, we arm you with a highly consistent modern stack (e.g. AWS, Kubernetes, Java, TypeScript, Python) and world-class AI-augmented SDLC tooling. We strip away the friction so you can focus on the problems that demand creativity and judgment. 

  • Ownership of Outcomes: Scaling global payments infrastructure requires individuals who take personal ownership of outcomes from day one. We look for builders who combine high agency with deep strategic alignment; channeling their urgency and relentless iteration into what matters most. 

  • Mission-Critical Accountability: We power payments infrastructure for global market leaders, making system trust and integrity our core deliverable. We don't treat compliance (PCI, SOC2, ISO27001), security patching, and platform maintenance as administrative overhead—we engineer them with first-class product discipline.  In payments infrastructure, reliability is not background work, it’s part of what customers buy.

 

Learn More: See how our engineering practices drive trust and innovation in our official blog and our reliability practices.

 

 

About the Role

As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer, you will be a key contributor and technical practitioner on our Platform Engineering team. You will help build, scale, and fortify global cloud infrastructure designed to handle mission-critical, high-throughput payments applications with zero downtime. You will own core platform components powering our payment systems. Working collaboratively within your team, you will execute infrastructure projects, uphold reliability standards, and help maintain our multi-region AWS environment. We are looking for hands-on engineers who take pride in solving complex distributed system challenges and continuously improving operational efficiency. If you thrive on solving technical infrastructure problems, building automated resiliency, and applying modern SRE practices, we want to build the future with you.

 

  • Build Immutable, Self-Healing Systems: Build, maintain, and optimize high-availability AWS infrastructure. You will contribute directly to our evolution toward a standardized, globally scalable fleet managed entirely through code.

  • Drive Resiliency & Automation: Reduce manual toil by implementing automated infrastructure solutions using GitOps, modern CI/CD pipelines, and IaC.

  • Deep Observability & Resiliency: Configure and maintain telemetry tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) to monitor performance and spot bottlenecks. You will participate in incident response on-call rotations and lead blameless post-mortems.

  • Enable Engineering Velocity: Partner with Product, Security, and Core Engineering teams to support adoption of "Golden Paths" that streamline developer workflows. You will mentor junior and mid-level engineers and foster strong technical practices.

  • Customer Impact: Maintain and support high-performance, low-latency private connectivity for external customer traffic. Partner with internal engineering teams to support platform adoption.

 

 

What You Bring

  • Ownership at Scale: 5+ years of experience contributing to complex, large-scale distributed systems within mission-critical environments.

  • AWS & Infrastructure-as-Code: Solid hands-on proficiency in AWS ecosystems and Terraform for building reproducible environments.

  • Containerization & Orchestration: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (EKS), Docker, and GitOps workflows (Flux, Argo, GitHub Actions).

  • Automation & Scripting: Proficient coding/scripting skills in Python, Go, or Bash for infrastructure automation and operational tooling.

  • Observability Expertise: Hands-on experience working with Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry.

  • Security & Networking Foundations: Good understanding of cloud security, API Gateways, load balancing, and network isolation principles.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with tokenization, payment processing, or security products

  • BA/BS degree

  • A knack for out-of-the-box thinking that thrives in a fast-paced startup environment

  • Experience with distributed data streaming platforms like Kafka (MSK).

  • Database performance tuning or query troubleshooting skills.

  • Familiarity with Java / Spring Framework services.

 

We're looking for passionate professionals who take pride in their craft and want to help grow a team tackling some of the most critical problems in payments. People who thrive here are curious by nature, unafraid of hard problems, and motivated by the chance to build something that matters at scale.

If you're driven to make a meaningful impact, work at the leading edge of payment technology, and grow your career alongside a team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning, you'll feel right at home at VGS.

Engineering at VGS
VGS is building the platform powering agentic commerce and global payments infrastructure. VGS Engineering is the pillar that supports that vision. We create a platform that is an indispensable, ubiquitous component of our partners' payments and security infrastructure. We build and operate high-scale, reliable, and resilient systems that manage mission-critical payment data across the globe. We don't just participate in the payments ecosystem; we power it.
 
Our Environment & Culture
Modern Tooling as Leverage: We value speed and impact. To ensure nothing slows you down, we arm you with a highly consistent modern stack (e.g. AWS, Kubernetes, Java, TypeScript, Python) and world-class AI-augmented SDLC tooling. We strip away the friction so you can focus on the problems that demand creativity and judgment. 
Ownership of Outcomes: Scaling global payments infrastructure requires individuals who take personal ownership of outcomes from day one. We look for builders who combine high agency with deep strategic alignment; channeling their urgency and relentless iteration into what matters most. 
Mission-Critical Accountability: We power payments infrastructure for global market leaders, making system trust and integrity our core deliverable. We don't treat compliance (PCI, SOC2, ISO27001), security patching, and platform maintenance as administrative overhead—we engineer them with first-class product discipline.  In payments infrastructure, reliability is not background work, it’s part of what customers buy.
 
Learn More: See how our engineering practices drive trust and innovation in our official blog and our reliability practices.
 

 
About the Role
As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a key contributor and technical practitioner on our Payments Acceptance team. In this role, you will help design, scale, and fortify global, high-throughput payment systems designed to execute mission-critical transactions with zero downtime. You will take direct ownership of expanding our high-impact Value-Added Services (VAS) including Network Tokens, Account Updater, 3DS, and Account Validation.
 
Working hand-in-hand with Tech Leads, Product Management, and adjacent platform teams, you will execute complex initiatives and uphold enterprise reliability standards. Rather than executing against rigid task lists or waiting for top-down instructions, you will bring high agency to your daily work, pioneering AI-native engineering methodologies and integrating agentic workflows across the entire SDLC. We are looking for hands-on product-minded builders who refuse to settle for the status quo, hate manual friction, and take immense pride in solving complex distributed systems challenges at 10,000+ TPS with exceptional quality, scalability, reliability, and security.
 

 
What You'll Do
Build Mission-Critical Payments Services: Design, build, and optimize high-availability, low-latency, and resilient Java microservices powering our core Payments Acceptance platform and Value-Added Services.
Drive AI-Native Engineering: Actively integrate AI-augmented development tools and agentic workflows into your daily SDLC—from rapid prototyping and automated code generation to comprehensive test suite creation and complex refactoring to eliminate friction and multiply delivery velocity.
Drive Resiliency & Automation: Eliminate manual toil by building automated, self-healing services using GitOps, modern CI/CD pipelines, and robust Infrastructure-as-Code practices.
Deep Observability & Operations: Configure and maintain telemetry tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) to proactively spot bottlenecks. You will participate in on-call rotations and lead blameless post-mortems to continuously harden system reliability.
Enable Engineering Velocity: Partner with cross-functional teams to build and adopt "Golden Paths" that streamline software delivery. Mentor mid-level and junior engineers while championing high code quality and testing standards.
Customer & Product Impact: Own service functionality end-to-end ensuring security, performance, and low latency for external customer traffic while supporting smooth platform adoption internally.
 

 
What You Bring
Ownership at Scale: 5+ years of software engineering experience taking personal ownership of features in complex, high-throughput distributed systems within mission-critical environments.
Java & Microservices Expertise: Proficiency in Java and modern frameworks (Spring/Spring Boot), with a strong command of REST API design, distributed architecture, and microservices design patterns.
Data & Messaging Systems: Hands-on experience with event-driven architectures, messaging systems (Kafka, SQS), and relational database tuning and performance optimization.
Cloud-Native & Containers: Solid hands-on experience with containerized delivery paradigms (Docker, Kubernetes/EKS) and public cloud ecosystems, preferably AWS.
Security & Compliance Foundations: Solid understanding of secure coding practices, API security, and operating within regulated compliance frameworks (PCI-DSS, SOC2).
Growth Mindset & High Agency: You're curious; you thrive at acquiring the context and asking questions needed to solve meaningful problems without needing every task spelled out. You have an innate drive to experiment, automate away repetitive tasks, and acquire whatever missing context is needed to solve complex technical challenges end-to-end.

Experience with tokenization, payment processing, or security products
BA/BS degree

Direct domain experience in payments (Network Tokens, Account Updater, or 3DS).
Hands-on experience leveraging AI developer tools, or agentic automation in day-to-day engineering workflows.

They come up infrequently but are time-sensitive and customer-visible. You'll have a written scope of what you can approve independently and what requires the manager, expanding as you establish a track record.

Serve as the senior decision-maker for the Support team during PT business hours. Escalations, judgment calls, and approvals land with you. You're the person on shift with the standing to decide, not to route.
Own incident and maintenance communications. Assess severity and customer impact, decide when to post to the public status page, write or approve the wording, including team drafts, and keep it up to date through resolution. 
Set and coordinate maintenance timing. Choose windows based on real customer traffic patterns and regional load, negotiate them with engineering, inform internal client-facing teams about and make sure the notice goes out with enough lead time for customers to plan.
Coordinate multi-team projects where Support is a stakeholder: migrations, deprecations, launches, and customer-specific rollouts. Track dependencies and keep the parties honest about status.
Debug deeply. Reproduce issues with cURL and Postman, read logs, and trace requests across VGS infrastructure, customer systems, and downstream gateways. Diagnose network problems independently: DNS, TCP/IP, routing, timeouts, connection resets, and TLS/SSL handshake failures.
Resolve an issue, find a workaround, or escalate with a bug report good enough for engineering to act on immediately.
Drive mid-tier and long tail customer integrations from kickoff to go-live, coordinating between customer engineers and internal teams.
Write up nontrivial investigations as internal runbooks or public documentation.
Prepare and deliver customer training, building the material where it doesn't exist.
Meet SLA and quality targets, and help the team meet theirs.
Participate in the weekend on-call rotation (every 3rd weekend, Saturday and Sunday, 8:00–20:00 PT). On-call is monitoring coverage, not a full working day — you respond to urgent incidents and time-sensitive requests, while routine tickets wait for the next business day.

Experience owning customer-facing incident or maintenance communication. You will be writing status page updates, incident notices, and escalation emails. You understand the difference between transparency and alarm.
Strong internal communication skills. You will be the translation layer between customers, VGS account management, and VGS product and engineering. You should be able to operate in different contexts and understand how to translate between the technical, operations, and business contexts of conversations to ensure context is not lost between stakeholders. Autonomy. You are comfortable deciding and then reporting, rather than checking first. You'll have a few hours of overlap with your manager each day and spend the rest of your shift as the main decision-maker.  
Strong command of HTTP, REST APIs, and proxies.Independent network debugging — DNS, TCP/IP, routing, connectivity, TLS/SSL handshakes. Be ready to describe a specific problem you diagnosed and how you narrowed it down.English at C1 or above, written and spoken. You'll be writing text that customers and executives read, under time pressure.
Willingness to work PT business hours on a sustained basis.

BA/BS degree

Reading and debugging code in at least one of Python, Go, Java, or a similar language. You won't ship production code.
